meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理神经影像数据为BIDS标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理MRI/EEG等神经影像数据并需要符合BIDS标准。
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroimaging data into BIDS standard format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with MRI/EEG neuroimaging data and need BIDS compliance.

howto.what: Claude 可以处理 BIDS 数据集的任务，包括组织数据、查询布局、验证合规性、转换 DICOM 到 BIDS、编写元数据侧车、创建衍生数据等。
howto.when: 当您要求处理 BIDS 数据集时触发，例如组织神经影像数据、查询文件、验证格式或转换 DICOM。

say.text: 帮我将 DICOM 文件转换成 BIDS 格式。
say.note: Claude 会使用 HeuDiConv 等工具进行转换。

say.text: 验证我的 BIDS 数据集是否符合规范。
查询我的 BIDS 数据集中有多少个被试。
say.note: Claude 会使用 PyBIDS 查询布局。

howto.what_en: Claude can handle BIDS dataset tasks: organizing data, querying layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, and creating derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work with a BIDS dataset, such as organizing neuroimaging data, querying files, validating format, or converting DICOM.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS format.
say_en.note: Claude will use HeuDiConv or similar tools.

say_en.text: Validate my BIDS dataset for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will run the BIDS validator.

say_en.text: How many subjects are in my BIDS dataset?
